statement.carrier: A finite length-n chain of stored real cores with bond dimensions d_0,...,d_n, each A_i(b) of shape d_i by d_(i+1), b in {0,1}.
statement.core_storage: Nested vectors with d_i rows and 2*d_(i+1) scalar columns; physical-bit/right-bond address b*d_(i+1)+j.
statement.word_product: For x=(x_0,...,x_(n-1)), M_x=A_0(x_0)...A_(n-1)(x_(n-1)); M_x has shape d_0 by d_n.
statement.gram: E_n=I_(d_n); E_i=sum_b A_i(b) E_(i+1) A_i(b)^T, shape d_i by d_i.
statement.complete_sum: E_0=sum_x M_x M_x^T, including every terminal-bond index in the internal multiplication.
statement.scalar_norm: When both end dimensions are one, output sqrt(E_0(0,0))=sqrt(sum_x M_x(0,0)^2), the unnormalized real Euclidean norm.
statement.norm_total_bound: n*(24*D^3+25*D^2+20*D+6)+5*D^2+4*D+9, assuming every bond dimension is at most D.
statement.empty_and_zero: No nonzero assumption; a zero-amplitude train returns zero. Empty scalar-boundary chain has identity amplitude and norm one. Internal zero dimensions are not excluded by the lesson.

Local retrospective source, no paper assimilation or novelty; unchanged signatures still require independent reconstruction/comparison.
Two real d_i by d_(i+1) matrices per site, nested-vector storage and bit-major flattened column address.
Ordered matrix product; terminal identity; two-branch right Gram recurrence.
E_0 equals the complete word sum of M_x M_x^T, not a selected branch sum.
All terminal labels retained; no projection; both end dimensions one imply scalar sum-of-squares norm.
Zero is allowed, empty scalar train has norm one, real Euclidean norm rather than complex or normalized-state theorem.
First supplied physical bit first, no little-endian wire equivalence; consumer bridge remains separate.
Cache tail once. For each b, F_b(a,j)=sum_t A_i(b)(a,t)E_(i+1)(t,j), then G_b(a,c)=sum_j F_b(a,j)A_i(b)(c,j). F shape l by m; G shape l by l; both inner sums length m.
Materialize G_0+G_1, transpose via core indices, stored terminal identity, final scalar read and one sqrt.

Entrywise finite-sum multiplication, chain induction, first-bit word split, tail identity, finite-sum distribution and (AB)^T=B^T A^T; scalar entry closes complete squares. Word enumeration belongs only to specification.

Returned value plus eight natural counters; componentwise additive composition; row/scalar two reads; multiplication/addition field charges; m-term dot product uses m multiplies and m adds including terminal zero.
Materialization overhead 4*(l*r+l) aggregate read/write charges; two stored accesses plus multiply/add cost six per inner term; B(l,m,r)=6*l*r*m+4*(l*r+l).
Two stored-entry accesses and one field addition per entry plus materialization: S(l)=9*l^2+4*l.
Two bit branches, each first and second products, then one sum. 2*B(l,m,m)+2*B(l,m,l)+S(l)=12*l*m^2+12*l^2*m+8*l*m+17*l^2+20*l.
Each recursion node adds six cache/traversal words; identity costs 5*r^2+4*r plus six; bond bound D and induction yield n*(24*D^3+25*D^2+20*D+6)+5*D^2+4*D+6.
Two-read scalar lookup plus one sqrt adds exactly three; eight counters remain meaningful, total is not wall-clock.
